verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Kit tracks unsubscribe and bounce events: it offers subscriber.unsubscribed and subscriber.bounced webhooks and reports unsubscribe and bounce rates. Event tracking and reporting are adjacent features, though, not documented automatic suppression. Nothing states that unsubscribed, bounced, or complaining contacts are automatically excluded across broadcasts, sequences, and automations, and spam complaints and CAN-SPAM/GDPR defaults are never mentioned.
